Subject: [PownceAPI] Re: JSON has incorrect Unicode characters


Wade,

It's a known issue, check out these threads:

	http://groups.google.com/group/pownceapi/browse_thread/thread/173afa74b6c02ee9
	http://groups.google.com/group/pownceapi/browse_thread/thread/d75425e7d4030988

My solution at the moment, at least until it's fixed, is to use the
XML format.

HTH,
Chris
